whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Green Life Dental Care,

I noticed your dental clinic has a perfect 5.0★ rating in Mithapur, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for new patient appointments.

Maine aapke clinic ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp appointment booking, pain-free dental treatments, aur clinic timings integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/greenlife

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Green Life Dental Care team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke dental clinic ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp booking and a showcase of your dental services in Mithapur. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact services, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
